concept: Parcel Alibi / The Doorbell Exposed Both Of Them
room_summary: Seven-route jam run after creator asked Codex to choose. The room selected Parcel Alibi because it has public recognition, concrete receipts, mutual guilt, active partner participation, a visual middle twist, and a taggable final thesis.
required_next_steps: Get creator idea approval or rejection.
If approved, write final slide copy and ask for copy lock.
After copy lock, run post-copy visual creative room before prompt pack or generation.
Generate proof-first if identity or style risk is high.
Only call final after native 4:5, separate native 9:16, visual QA, and final audit exist.

candidate_slide_spine.text: Some couples do not receive parcels.
candidate_slide_spine.scene: Doorway wide shot: delivery box enters the home; both faces already know there is a story.
She shields one box with serious courtroom energy.
Close on her hands holding the parcel; his eyebrow rises.
He opens his own box; she gives the deadpan look.
Both freeze mid-defense, eyes locked on the door.
Both crouch and slide boxes behind the sofa together.

candidate_slide_spine.text: Maybe love is one shared alibi.
candidate_slide_spine.scene: They sit beside the half-hidden boxes, relieved and conspiratorial.
